title: Cerebras CS-3 晶圓尺度叢集
summary: 以本地 SRAM、權重串流與晶圓尺度通信解析Cerebras CS-3 晶圓尺度叢集：六個原理與架構單元、十二項可保存的分析及驗證作業，附假想量化例、來源及衍生工程比較。
summaryEn: Explore Cerebras CS-3 wafer-scale cluster through local sram, weight streaming and wafer-scale communication: six principle/architecture units and twelve saved analysis/validation tasks, with an assumed numerical example, primary sources and related engineering comparisons.
scope: 原創張量、運算成本及失效分析。架構圖是功能教學示意，非晶片floorplan或專有電路；數字為假想，需依精度、shape、資料分佈與系統邊界重算。
scopeEn: Original tensor, compute-cost and failure analysis. Functional diagrams are not chip floorplans/proprietary circuits; assumed values need recalculation for precision, shape, data and boundaries.

stages.title: 系統邊界與基本原理
stages.description: 在Cerebras CS-3 晶圓尺度叢集案例中比較WSE本地core與SRAM與MemoryX參數流，各完成分析及驗證。
stages.descriptionEn: Analyze and validate wse local cores and sram and memoryx parameter streaming within the Cerebras CS-3 wafer-scale cluster case.

steps.title: 晶圓網格與局部記憶：架構分析
steps.titleEn: Wafer meshes and local memory: architecture analysis
steps.objective: 針對WSE本地core與SRAM提出可反駁的晶圓網格與局部記憶模型與驗證紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Produce a falsifiable wafer meshes and local memory model and evidence record for wse local cores and sram.
steps.instruction: 在「Cerebras CS-3 晶圓尺度叢集」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識WSE本地core與SRAM。晶圓尺度將多核心與本地SRAM相連；避開部分離片搬運但仍有通信和容量限制。 建立晶圓網格與局部記憶的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是本地 SRAM、權重串流與晶圓尺度通信。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。比較鄰近交換與跨片搬運的假想bytes。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
steps.instructionEn: Identify wse local cores and sram in the mentor diagram and primary sources for Cerebras CS-3 wafer-scale cluster. Wafer-scale cores connect local SRAM; some off-chip traffic is avoided, with remaining capacity/communication limits. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of wafer meshes and local memory, focusing on local sram, weight streaming and wafer-scale communication. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Compare assumed neighbor exchange and off-chip bytes. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.
steps.observation: 比較鄰近交換與跨片搬運的假想bytes。
steps.observationEn: Compare assumed neighbor exchange and off-chip bytes.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：沒有傳統cache就表示記憶體無限。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: No conventional cache means unlimited memory.
steps.check: 提交WSE本地core與SRAM的系統邊界圖、兩案例計算、單位／不確定度表及一項能區分競爭機制的證據。
steps.checkEn: Submit a boundary diagram, two-case calculation, units/uncertainty table and discriminating evidence for wse local cores and sram.

knowledge.title: 晶圓網格與局部記憶
knowledge.text: 晶圓尺度將多核心與本地SRAM相連；避開部分離片搬運但仍有通信和容量限制。 本課架構對應：WSE本地core與SRAM
knowledge.textEn: Wafer-scale cores connect local SRAM; some off-chip traffic is avoided, with remaining capacity/communication limits. Course architecture correspondence: WSE local cores and SRAM

knowledge.title: 獨立驗證與失效邊界
knowledge.text: 比較鄰近交換與跨片搬運的假想bytes。 應逐項保留基準與不確定度；沒有傳統cache就表示記憶體無限。 是本單元要排除的誤解。
knowledge.textEn: Compare assumed neighbor exchange and off-chip bytes. Retain each reference and uncertainty; reject the misconception: No conventional cache means unlimited memory.

knowledge.title: 原創假想量化練習
knowledge.text: 假設算術強度 I=6 FLOP/byte、頻寬 B=0.9 TB/s、計算峯值 42 TFLOP/s，理想 roofline=min(42,I×B)=5.4 TFLOP/s。皆非產品規格，未含同步、精度轉換或工作形狀損失。
knowledge.textEn: Assume I=6 FLOP/byte, B=0.9 TB/s and compute peak 42 TFLOP/s: ideal roofline min(42,I×B)=5.4 TFLOP/s. These are not product specifications; synchronization, precision conversion and shape inefficiency are omitted.

quiz.question: 就WSE本地core與SRAM的「晶圓網格與局部記憶」，哪個推論或驗證成立？
quiz.questionEn: Which inference or check is justified for wafer meshes and local memory in wse local cores and sram?
options: 晶圓尺度將多核心與本地SRAM相連；避開部分離片搬運但仍有通信和容量限制。
沒有傳統cache就表示記憶體無限。
兩個案例的平均相同，就足以排除空間、時間及模型誤差。
optionsEn: Wafer-scale cores connect local SRAM; some off-chip traffic is avoided, with remaining capacity/communication limits.
No conventional cache means unlimited memory.
Equal case averages rule out spatial, temporal and model errors.
quiz.explanation: 晶圓尺度將多核心與本地SRAM相連；避開部分離片搬運但仍有通信和容量限制。 比較鄰近交換與跨片搬運的假想bytes。
quiz.explanationEn: Wafer-scale cores connect local SRAM; some off-chip traffic is avoided, with remaining capacity/communication limits. Compare assumed neighbor exchange and off-chip bytes.

steps.title: 晶圓網格與局部記憶：證據驗證
steps.titleEn: Wafer meshes and local memory: evidence validation
steps.objective: 針對WSE本地core與SRAM提出可反駁的晶圓網格與局部記憶模型與驗證紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Produce a falsifiable wafer meshes and local memory model and evidence record for wse local cores and sram.
steps.instruction: 沿用前一步「晶圓網格與局部記憶」模型，檢查WSE本地core與SRAM的兩個假想案例。比較鄰近交換與跨片搬運的假想bytes。 先訂可接受誤差，再比較預測與獨立計算；區分晶圓尺度將多核心與本地SRAM相連；避開部分離片搬運但仍有通信和容量限制。與另一個可能造成相同輸出的機制。保存輸入、殘差、不確定度及採信／保留理由。缺少公開資料就標示尚未驗證，不補造產品數字。
steps.instructionEn: Use the previous wafer meshes and local memory model to inspect two hypothetical cases involving wse local cores and sram. Compare assumed neighbor exchange and off-chip bytes. Set acceptable error before comparing predictions with an independent calculation. Distinguish "Wafer-scale cores connect local SRAM; some off-chip traffic is avoided, with remaining capacity/communication limits." from an alternative cause with similar output. Save inputs, residuals, uncertainty and accept/hold reasoning. Mark absent public evidence as unverified rather than inventing product values.
steps.observation: 比較鄰近交換與跨片搬運的假想bytes。
steps.observationEn: Compare assumed neighbor exchange and off-chip bytes.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：沒有傳統cache就表示記憶體無限。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: No conventional cache means unlimited memory.
steps.check: 提交WSE本地core與SRAM的系統邊界圖、兩案例計算、單位／不確定度表及一項能區分競爭機制的證據。
steps.checkEn: Submit a boundary diagram, two-case calculation, units/uncertainty table and discriminating evidence for wse local cores and sram.

steps.title: 權重串流與分離：架構分析
steps.titleEn: Weight streaming and disaggregation: architecture analysis
steps.objective: 針對MemoryX參數流提出可反駁的權重串流與分離模型與驗證紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Produce a falsifiable weight streaming and disaggregation model and evidence record for memoryx parameter streaming.
steps.instruction: 在「Cerebras CS-3 晶圓尺度叢集」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識MemoryX參數流。參數可存於獨立記憶系統並串流到計算；通信帶寬與更新一致性是關鍵邊界。 建立權重串流與分離的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是本地 SRAM、權重串流與晶圓尺度通信。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。畫前傳、反傳及參數更新的方向。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
steps.instructionEn: Identify memoryx parameter streaming in the mentor diagram and primary sources for Cerebras CS-3 wafer-scale cluster. Separate memory can stream weights to compute; bandwidth and update consistency remain key. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of weight streaming and disaggregation, focusing on local sram, weight streaming and wafer-scale communication. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Draw forward, backward and update directions. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.
steps.observation: 畫前傳、反傳及參數更新的方向。
steps.observationEn: Draw forward, backward and update directions.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：參數與計算分離就完全不需要通信。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: Disaggregating parameters removes communication.
steps.check: 提交MemoryX參數流的系統邊界圖、兩案例計算、單位／不確定度表及一項能區分競爭機制的證據。
steps.checkEn: Submit a boundary diagram, two-case calculation, units/uncertainty table and discriminating evidence for memoryx parameter streaming.
